verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships agent-directed markdown. Its Codex/OpenCode install path has the user tell the agent to fetch and follow a raw GitHub INSTALL.md, and its skills are plain SKILL.md documentation written for agents to read. However, nothing shows an llms.txt or an agent-oriented index of the product's own docs, and the .md docs probe returned 404. Missing for 10: llms.txt or llms-full.txt, a first-party agent-readable docs index, first-party documentation of the agent-fetch install flow beyond a community report.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: you tell the agent to fetch and follow instructions from a raw GitHub INSTALL.md
write the skill (documentation), watch tests pass (agents comply)
Skills are plain, selectively-installable markdown folders.
